_comments.studioName: Set during her first-run onboarding. Shown as the arcade title.
_comments.dailyWorldLimit: Hard cap on Marble world generations per day. Enforced in mcp/lib/limit.js, not just instructions.
_comments.timezone: IANA timezone the daily limit resets at midnight in. Handles DST automatically.
_comments.marbleModel: marble-1.1 (1500 credits, fixed) or marble-1.1-plus (1500 + 300 per dynamic cube, max 5).
_comments.splatQuality: Which Gaussian splat level-of-detail to download: 100k, 500k, or full_res. 500k is the phone-friendly default.
_comments.requireShipApproval: false = /ship publishes immediately. true = /ship stages the game and waits for Dad to approve.
_comments.imageProvider: Which concept-image API to use. Only 'gemini' is implemented; the adapter in mcp/lib/images.js is where a new one would go.
_comments.imageModel: Image model id. gemini-3.1-flash-image is the current one; gemini-2.5-flash-image also works.
_comments.maxHeroRevisions: How many times she can redraw the hero concept image before it is locked in. Keeps the image bill bounded.
_comments.backupPath: Second location worlds/ is mirrored to by `npm run backup`. Any path: external drive, synced folder, rclone mount. Empty means manifest-only.
